chapter: Howard McGhee's band and bebop in LA
title: Jack's Basket Room and Wild Bill Moore as impresario
summary: After-hours at Jack's Basket Room where Wild Bill Moore handled the hiring.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: We'd go from place to place and play all around at the after-hour spots. Jack's Basket was up on Central and 27th, or 29th, something like that. It was very popular. It was a bigger place. And during this time, Wild Bill Moore had moved out here, and he was kind of like the impresario at Jack's Basket -- the music impresario. He was dealing out

the gigs, doing the hiring, you know. But later on... He did a lot of hiring when things got tougher later. All of us was working for him. You know, he was getting the jobs... He was a good businessman. You know, we were just running around, playing and having fun.
